sgsim.title: Silent Gear Simulator
sgsim.grade_all.tooltip: Set the grade of every unit in this part
sgsim.grade_all.tooltip2: Left-click / scroll up: higher. Right-click / scroll down: lower
sgsim.cell.rejected: The server's recipe would not accept this material/grade here
sgsim.mixed.tooltip:
Off: picking a material for one unit fills the whole part.
On: every unit can use a different material (standard Silent Gear only crafts parts made of one material).
sgsim.give.tooltip: Put this exact item in your inventory. Only works in creative mode.
sgsim.hover_hint: Hover the icon for the real tooltip
sgsim.problem.exception: Silent Gear raised an error while building this item: %s
sgsim.problem.bad_count: %s with %s materials has no recipe on this server (allowed: %s)
sgsim.problem.unknown_material: Material %s does not exist on this server
sgsim.problem.rejected: %s (%s) is not accepted for %s by the server's recipe
sgsim.problem.mixed: %s uses more than one material; standard Silent Gear recipes reject this
sgsim.problem.part_unresolved: Silent Gear did not recognise the %s
sgsim.problem.main_not_allowed: Silent Gear refuses to craft this %s (the material has no durability for this gear type)
sgsim.problem.upgrade_refused: %s cannot be applied to this item
sgsim.cell.fixed: Only made by a %s recipe here: the part comes out exactly as that recipe defines it (grade can't be chosen)
sgsim.problem.fixed_part: %s is made with %s on this server, so it is used exactly as that recipe outputs it
sgsim.problem.fixed_grade_ignored: Grades set on %s are ignored: that recipe decides them
sgsim.page_hint: ← / → (or Silent Gear's cycle keys): other part pages
sgsim.cell.substitute: Made by using %s directly as this part: it comes out exactly as Silent Gear makes it (grade can't be chosen)
sgsim.cell.other: Silent Gear allows this material here, but the grid recipe refuses it. Likely made by: %s
sgsim.problem.substitute: %s is used directly as the %s (Silent Gear part substitute)
sgsim.problem.other_route: %s from %s isn't made in the crafting grid here; assumed made by %s with the materials shown (couldn't verify). Grades can be added afterwards in the Material Grader if part grading is on.
sgsim.cell.fixed_gradable: Made by a %s recipe, then graded by putting the finished part in a Material Grader (one unit per pass, highest grade kept first)
sgsim.problem.fixed_part_graded: %s: made with %s, then graded in the Material Grader as shown
sgsim.sort.name: Name
sgsim.sort.tooltip: Choose a stat to sort by (value this material gives this part, at the unit's grade)
sgsim.toggle.properties.tooltip: Always show Silent Gear's stats (as if holding its stats key, Ctrl by default)
sgsim.toggle.traits.tooltip: Always show trait descriptions (as if holding Shift / Alt)
sgsim.toggle.construction.tooltip: Always show the item's construction: parts and materials (as if holding Alt)
